summary: Ambient: slow or no pulse, long sustained chords, pads, bells and space; no drums or very soft ones
body: No beat, or a very soft one; the pulse comes from slow repetition.
Harmony: long chords (2–8 bars each), major 7ths, sus chords, I–IV or I–vi; slow attacks and releases.
Sounds: pads, bells, choir, processed piano; long reverbs and echoes.
Moving toward ambient: thin out the drums first (fade or drop them), then lengthen the chords and add space.
Apply: pattern/prog-ambient-characteristic-3 on the keys. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 60–90 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
